description: This file defines an abstract class 'ConnectionListener' responsible for managing network connections, accepting incoming connections, handling connection lifecycle, and logging related events within the Orleans runtime infrastructure.

classes.name: ConnectionListener
classes.description: An abstract class that manages network connection acceptance, lifecycle, and logging within the Orleans runtime. It handles binding to network endpoints, accepting incoming connections, starting/stopping the listener, and managing active connections.

methods.name: ConnectionListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connection listener with factory, options, connection manager, and shared connection state.

methods.name: Endpoint
methods.description: Abstract property to get the network endpoint the listener is bound to.

methods.name: ServiceProvider
methods.description: Provides access to the service provider from shared connection state.

methods.name: NetworkingTrace
methods.description: Provides access to the networking trace logger from shared connection state.

methods.name: ConnectionOptions
methods.description: Property holding the connection options configuration.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new connection instance from a connection context.

methods.name: ConnectionDelegate
methods.description: Property that lazily initializes and returns the connection delegate used to configure connections.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Virtual method to allow derived classes to configure the connection builder.

methods.name: BindAsync
methods.description: Binds the listener to its network endpoint asynchronously.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the accept loop after binding the listener.

methods.name: RunAcceptLoop
methods.description: Main loop accepting incoming connections asynchronously and handling exceptions.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully stops the listener, unbinds, closes active connections, and disposes resources.

methods.name: StartConnection
methods.description: Adds a new connection to active connections and queues its run asynchronously.

methods.name: RunConnectionAsync
methods.description: Runs the connection, logs termination, and removes it from active connections.

methods.name: BeginConnectionScope
methods.description: Creates a logging scope for a connection if enabled.
